name: ON
tagline: Charging stations, charging history and invoices from ON
description: Check your charging history, registered cars and invoices with ON (Orka náttúrunnar), and find available charging stations. You can also start and stop charging through ON’s older system. That system is being phased out, so those functions may stop working.
examples: How many kilowatt-hours did I use for charging last month?
Is there an available charger near Selfoss right now?

tools.name: monta_charges
tools.description: Charge history from the Monta backend

tools.name: monta_charge_points
tools.description: Charge points from the Monta backend

tools.name: session
tools.description: One charging session by id (legacy backend)

tools.name: live
tools.description: Active sessions, reservations and counters (legacy backend)

tools.name: locations
tools.description: Charging locations near a point, no login needed

tools.name: start_charging
tools.description: Start charging at a given EVSE/connector

envVars.name: ON_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Override the legacy Dusky API base URL

envVars.name: ON_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES
envVars.description: Set to 1 to expose start/stop charging MCP tools

is.tagline: Hleðslustöðvar, hleðslusaga og reikningar hjá ON
is.description: Skoðaðu hleðslusöguna þína, skráða bíla og reikninga hjá Orku náttúrunnar og finndu lausar hleðslustöðvar. Einnig er hægt að hefja og stöðva hleðslu í gegnum eldra kerfi ON. Verið er að leggja það kerfi niður, svo sá hluti tólsins gæti hætt að virka.
examples: Hversu margar kílóvattstundir notaði ég við hleðslu í síðasta mánuði?
Er laus hleðslustöð nálægt Selfossi núna?
Stöðvaðu hleðsluna sem er í gangi.
